state:
Goal `core-net-listener-and-1-more`. The whole `Core\Net\Listener` group owes nothing: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Net\Listener'` passes.
`Core\Net\Stream` has its class card (`STREAM_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs`) and is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.
`Core\Net\Stream::close` owes nothing. Its tests, and the tests of `read` and `write`, are credited by `covers:` markers on the Rust test `a_listener_times_out_takes_a_waiting_connection_and_refuses_once_closed` and on the two `net-*` conformance cases that call them.
`Core\Net\Stream::read` and `Core\Net\Stream::write` still owe examples, hostile and perf, and nothing else.
Nothing is blocked. `bun nv verify` was green at the end of this session.

items.text: **`Core\Net\Stream::read`** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: three examples, `about.md`, one attack, one bench. Examples: a read returns at most `$max` bytes; a read past the end returns no bytes; a `TimeoutError` when nothing arrives. Attack: a huge `$max`, `$max` of 0, a read that waits on a peer that never writes. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1567`, card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:520`

**`Core\Net\Stream::write`** — the same proofs, then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Net\Stream'`. Examples: `write` returns the count written; a write to a closed peer throws `IOError`; a small line protocol. Attack: one very large payload, an empty payload, writes to a peer that never reads. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1600`, card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:556`

backlog: A connect plus accept over loopback costs about 15 ms per pair on Windows (`Core\Net\Listener::accept`'s recorded figure is about 30 ms for two). That is one timer tick, and it looks like a wait in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs` or the reactor. Not checked where. Owner: whoever next touches the reactor's wait; `docs/perf/members.ndjson` has the figure.
